scenarios.prompt: The project wants coyote and pre-landing buffer. Publish logical durations, start/expire/consume events and one-shot consumption without changing the jump arc.

criteria.ownership: Is the single owner of coyote, jump buffer and corner-forgiveness policy.
criteria.boundaries: Durations are project data on the logical clock with deterministic start/expiry/consume boundaries.
criteria.evidence: Tests before/at/after expiry at multiple render rates and verifies stale input is not consumed twice.
